card.statement:
We give a canonical form of matrices of a cycle of linear or semilinear mapping $V_1\,\text{---}\,V_2\,
\text{---}\:\cdots\:\text{---}\,V_t\,
\text{---}\,V_1$ in which all $V_i$ are complex vector spaces, each line is an arrow $\longrightarrow$ or $\longleftarrow$, and each arrow denotes a linear or semilinear mapping.
card.label: Abstract

paper.title: Cycles of linear and semilinear mappings
paper.abstract: We give a canonical form of matrices of a cycle of linear or semilinear mapping V_1 --- V_2 --- ... --- V_t --- V_1 in which all V_i are complex vector spaces, each line is an arrow ---> or <---, and each arrow denotes a linear or semilinear mapping.
